NOT_authoritative_for: any other hardware class — scripts/adr051_slo_gate.py refuses a cross-class comparison
supersedes: nothing. This is the FIRST anchor for hardware_class dev1-slo-v1, and the numbers in docs/bench/adr-051-baseline-dev1.json may NOT be read into it. That predecessor was measured with the Redis fleet on the colima-db Docker daemon — the same VM as the 3.6M-row EODHD corpus and unrelated testcontainer churn. dev1-slo-v1 runs the fleet on a dedicated 4 vCPU / 4 GiB colima-slo profile on internal storage, with nothing else permitted on that daemon. A different measurement plane is a different question.
caveat:
Recorded on the self-hosted Actions runner with the load generator CO-LOCATED with the proxy on the same cores. It is a REGRESSION anchor and states no capacity; config/performance-surface.toml declares this class slo_declarable = false for that reason.

BOX STATE. The host reservation drained ordinary work on the other runner applications before measuring, quiescence was established from sustained load1/load5/load15 below 0.20/0.25/0.30 of 14 cpus, and the exclusivity assertion recorded zero non-owner ACTIVE records, zero macOS Runner.Worker processes and zero Runner.Worker processes inside the colima VM -- the last of which no macOS process scan can establish.

THE BAND COVERS THE SAMPLE, which is the property that makes this anchor usable: p99 reps span 18,771-31,332us, a max/median of 1.26x against the declared 1.30x tolerance, and throughput spans 15,543.4-16,164.1 rps (+/-2%). Every rep that declared this anchor passes the gate the anchor produces -- checked mechanically rather than asserted.

The tail is still the looser half and a tail regression smaller than that spread will not be caught here. Tightening it needs a dedicated load generator, not a narrower tolerance.

recorded.serving_mode: delegated-required-only (ADR-MCPRE-052; delegated-credential-backed response signature per request)
recorded.carrier: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures + RFC 9530 Content-Digest
recorded.provenance:
GitHub Actions run 34703904633, job 'SLO lane (local_gate.sh stage 4)' on runner dev1-mcp-re, reports retained as artifact slo-reports-dev1-slo-v1-34703904633.

NOT declared from run 34683989229, the first measurement on this plane, although that run also measured cleanly. Its p99 reps spanned 17,343-29,772us -- a max/median spread of 1.42x against a declared tolerance of 1.30x -- so the ceiling THAT anchor produced (27,218us) would have rejected one of the six reps that defined it. An anchor whose own sample falls outside the band it generates is flaky by construction, and it proved so on the very next measurement, failing at 1.1% over. `anchor_consistency_defects()` in scripts/slo_evidence_identity.py now refuses such a declaration; it was added because this one shipped without it.

measurement_plane.note: Verified against the declaration by tools/slo/environment_preflight.py before the measurement began; a mismatch on any field refuses the run.

anchor.comment: MEDIAN of 6 reps at the canonical v2 envelope (concurrency 128 / 8000 requests / cold TLS1.3-mTLS, 1 declared core), every rep 8000/8000 successes and 0 failures. scripts/adr051_slo_gate.py compares a fresh run of THIS config on THIS class against these numbers, under the tolerances in docs/bench/adr-051-slo-targets.json.
